# Local math renderer

MathJax 3.2.2, `es5/tex-svg.js`, from the official npm package:
https://registry.npmjs.org/mathjax/-/mathjax-3.2.2.tgz

Apache License 2.0: see MathJax-LICENSE.txt. This combined component includes TeX/AMS parsing, SVG output and glyph data. formiX enables base/AMS input only, disables automatic typesetting and package loading, and uses `fontCache: none` for standalone vector exports. No renderer CDN or font download is needed at runtime.
